title: Sverins / Uisima rescue
summary: Break Sverins' control and subdue Uisima for the ranger rescue.
overview: Break Sverins' control and subdue Uisima for the ranger rescue.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for linked acolytes and golem-bound spirits alongside the named enemies.
Keep healing ready for Sverins' recurring Matter Dispersal.
Lower Uisima to 10% and allow the surrender condition to complete after the other threats are handled.
The eligible ranger should finish the conversation and quest hand-in after Uisima is freed.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
